headline: Flagler finish the conference table unbeaten
dek: Flagler's only dropped points in conference play came in a draw at home to North Georgia in September, and their only defeat of the season at Florida Southern the following Wednesday. They take fourteen wins and four draws into Sunday's match at home to Lynn, as North Georgia go to Catawba after Friday's win at West Alabama.
displaced_by: North Georgia have played at West Alabama and Flagler now have a match against Lynn on the calendar, so the standing lines' claim that North Georgia alone had matches left is no longer true.

pattern.label: derived
pattern.text: Fifteen different players have scored North Georgia's 48 goals, so their attack is spread across the squad rather than leaning on one scorer.

wire.line: Flagler have won every match since Florida Southern beat them in September.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Six matches have passed their date with no published result, every one of them from August.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Middle Georgia State have conceded 54 goals, more than any other programme in the conference, while scoring 29.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Isaac Calderon has scored twelve of North Georgia's 48 goals from 55 shots.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Javier Gongora Andres has scored eleven of Middle Georgia State's 29 goals from 55 shots.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Finn Weigelt has scored eleven of Flagler's 42 goals from 38 shots.

last_match.line: West Alabama have now lost to every side from this conference they have faced, at home and away.

next_match.line: North Georgia are unbeaten against sides from outside this conference this season.

validation.policy: observed and derived claims are recomputed against the data home before publish; failures are dropped, not softened. signal and projected pass on schema unless the data contradicts a figure. context is never validated as a finding.
